sloka: प्रचोद्यमानेन मया गच्छ इति बहुशः तया ।प्रत्युक्ता मैथिली वाक्यम् इदम् तत् प्रत्यय अन्वितम् ॥३-५९-९॥
transliteration: pracodyamānena mayā gaccha iti bahuśaḥ tayā ।pratyuktā maithilī vākyam idam tat pratyaya anvitam ॥3-59-9॥

translations.english: When I was repeated asked to go, I said this in order to instil confidence in the princess from Mithila :
